caseNameFull: Lewis, Director of Corrections of Arizona v. Harding

opinions.text:
Application to vacate the stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice O’Connor, and by her referred to the Court, granted, and it is ordered that the order *968staying the execution entered by the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit on April 2, 1992, is vacated.

JUSTICE Blackmun and Justice Stevens would deny the application.
